notes.title: Synchronize all your Striker Manager 3 accounts
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719830/Striker_Manager_3__Online_Football_Manager/

For this new season we have solved one of the requests we received the most from you. All those users who registered to Striker Manager 3 through Steam or other applications (Android, iOS, Epic or Elixir) can now synchronize their accounts with the web browser and, in this way, take advantage of all the Premium features of Striker Manager 3.

[b]For users registered from Steam[/b]
First of all, click on your username. Then, in the top menu, click on “My Account” and there will appear an editable field called “Email”. Write the email with which you want your Striker Manager 3 account to be associated and then confirm the email. Finally, in the “New Password” field, you must enter the password to access your account and then enter it again in the “Repeat Password” field. Finally click on “Save Changes” and you are all set.

If you have any doubt please open a ticket through our Discord channel and we will try to solve it. Thank you very much!
